description: We challenge ideas, solve problems and transform imagination into meaningful discoveries.
summary: This project explores comets, also known as the icy visitors of space. It explains what comets are, how they are made of ice, dust and rock, and why they develop glowing tails when approaching the Sun. Students will discover the origins of comets, including the Kuiper Belt and Oort Cloud. The project also introduces interesting facts about comets and their journey through the solar system. It aims to increase students' curiosity and interest in astronomy and space exploration.
details: The project is presented through an educational infographic poster. It explains the structure and composition of comets, the formation of their glowing tails and their origins in the outer solar system. Simple illustrations and descriptions are used to help students understand these scientific concepts. The poster also includes fun facts to make learning more interesting and engaging. It is specially designed for lower secondary students to explore and appreciate the wonders of space.
